purpose: Implement Quality Engineering-owned diagnostic EG-MATRIX exact-target runner capability without application behavior or Qualification Cell advancement.

change.public_seam: cargo xtask quality returned EG-MATRIX verdict and immutable retained report

dependency_review.rationale: Uses the Rust standard library, existing sha2 dependency, and existing controlled-execution owner.

runner_contract: exact-targets.tsv is a bounded frozen ordered registry containing exactly compile, contract, protocol, producer, provider, platform, architecture, filesystem, StorageClass, registry, distribution, SDK, compatibility, and evidence targets once each.

Every target binds EG-MATRIX, Quality Engineering ownership, PR|EXT stage, diagnostic-only classification, concrete canonical identity, timeout, cargo tool identity/version, canonical argv, explicit environment, input digest, registry digest, plan digest, result, and controlled execution lifecycle evidence.

The runner reuses controlled_execution for launch, bounded capture, process-group reconciliation, deadline, cancellation marker, missing-tool, and first-failure retention; it does not duplicate lifecycle ownership.
matrix_verifier independently re-loads descriptors and derives plan, tool, argv, environment, input, timeout, ordering, and detail expectations without calling the runner execution-plan builder.
QUAL executes no M0 diagnostic target and remains rejected by the existing exact-artifact qualification boundary; no matrix target, emulator, fixture, or local run becomes Qualified.

initial_red.result: Failed before implementation because EG-MATRIX performed generation parity only and retained no exact target executions.

detection_gained: Missing, malformed, oversized, duplicate, reordered, stale, noncanonical owner/stage/gate/timeout, non-diagnostic, or identity-less matrix rows fail closed before execution.

Each selected diagnostic target produces an independent controlled step; nonzero, malformed output, deadline, cancellation, capture ceiling, missing tool, and retry-to-green retain a failed first attempt and never fall back.
Golden and intentionally invalid descriptor fixtures exercise canonical registry parity and the retained negative path; parent evidence validation rejects tampered raw matrix evidence.

migration.to: Frozen diagnostic target descriptors plus controlled per-target runner and independent retained verifier
migration.rollback: Revert this policy record, registry, runner modules, fixtures, and tests together; retained evidence remains immutable.

qualification_claim: None. This is diagnostic Quality Engineering harness behavior only. No exact target or Qualification Cell is Qualified, merge eligible, released, or deployed.
